name: Mobile device management and supervision
plain: A company server controls the phone's settings, apps and restrictions.
meaning: MDM can install apps, set Wi-Fi and VPN, block features and wipe the device. Supervised iOS devices allow tighter control, such as app lockdown and content filters.

android.permission: Provisioning for device owner; Android Management API
android.prompt_ui: QR provisioning, zero touch, managed Google Play
android.note: Work profile keeps personal data separate; fully managed gives full control.

ios.prompt_ui: Profile install with consent; Apple Business Manager automatic enrollment
ios.api_surface: MDM protocol, Declarative Device Management, ABM, DEP
ios.note: User Enrollment limits what MDM can see.

limits.headline: Can control settings, apps and restrictions on the phone, once a company enrolls it
limits.user_action: You enroll the phone with your company by QR code, profile install or automatic setup
can: Lock down apps and filter content on supervised iPhones
cannot: See everything on iPhone with User Enrollment; it limits what the company sees
See personal data in an Android work profile
Control the phone without your enrollment steps or Apple Business Manager setup
limits.differs: Android has a work profile or full management; iPhone has User Enrollment and stronger control on supervised phones.

story.what_it_is: A company server that controls a phone's settings, apps and restrictions.

marketing.name: Device management
marketing.pitch: Apple lets organizations configure, manage and secure iPhones and iPads at scale.

story.for_you: At work or school you tap a link to enroll, and the phone starts to follow rules. Your boss may install apps, set Wi-Fi, block features or wipe the device. With personal phones the work part can be kept apart.
story.for_makers: Companies and schools run thousands of phones from one dashboard. They push apps, set VPN and Wi-Fi, block features, and wipe lost devices. Supervised devices give much more control than personal ones.

use_cases.example: IT sets up a new hire's phone with email, Wi-Fi and the right apps before the first day.
A school locks iPads to learning apps during class.
A hospital pushes a clinical app to every nurse's phone.
An airline updates every pilot's tablet at once.
A courier company installs a route app and blocks other apps on driver phones.
A security team wipes a lost phone from a web page.
A parent uses a family device manager to set up a child's phone.

story.android_note: A work profile keeps personal data apart, while a fully managed device gives the company full control.
story.ios_note: User Enrollment limits what management can see on a personal iPhone. Supervised devices give much broader control.
